Definition: to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; to shake a tree
BiblicalUsage: 1) to glorify, beautify, adorn; 1a) (Piel) to glorify, beautify; 1b) (Hithpael); 1b1) to glorify oneself; 1b2) to get glory to oneself, be glorified; 2) (Piel) to go over the boughs
